title.narrative: The Hague Convention of 1954 and its Protocols: opportunities for use and promotion

description.narrative: The project aims to develop informational materials – videos – on the provisions of the 1954 Hague Convention and its Protocols (1954 and 1999) and to promote UNESCO values through the Convention's instruments in cooperation with the UNESCO Creative Cities Network, the Global Network of UNESCO Cities in Training, the UNESCO Associated Schools Network, UNESCO Chairs and Clubs. The project aims to raise awareness, engagement and support of the public for cultural heritage sites through communication. Objectives of this project are to familiarise citizens with the basic principles of protecting cultural property and combating illicit trafficking in cultural property in times of war and to develop and implement information materials (videos) for different target audiences on international standards and best practices in the implementation of the Convention and its two Protocols.
